featured_reviews.name: varun
featured_reviews.review_text: They charged 1100 for ironing and gave my clothes back the way they were. They have taken advantage of the fact the shirts are new and I wont notice. Manager is not answering calls

featured_reviews.name: Sachin
featured_reviews.review_text: Very disappointed with this dry cleaner. They completely ruined my friend’s bag that we brought in for cleaning, and when we pointed it out, they refused to take any responsibility or offer any help. Extremely unprofessional and careless with customers’ belongings. I would not recommend their services to anyone.

featured_reviews.name: Pankaj Desai
featured_reviews.review_text: Tumbledry is a great laundry and dry cleaning service. They always pick up and deliver clothes on time. My clothes came back very clean, fresh, and nicely packed. The staff is polite and helpful. The prices are reasonable and the whole process is simple. I’m very happy with their service and will continue using them.

featured_reviews.name: Deeshaa Diggikar
featured_reviews.review_text: I was a regular customer here, but they disappointed me by ruining a brand new expensive jacket. The colour was faded and the fitting was loosened up. I don’t know how roughly it was handled it lost all the freshness and fitting. There were also white iron marks all over the jacket. After reporting they are not even accepting their mistake. Very horrible service and not at all trustworthy.

featured_reviews.name: Maroof Ashahar Ansari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely the worst experience deeply disappointing and emotionally draining.

If you're even slightly considering giving your clothes to Trumble Dry Lower Parel Branch, please think twice. Honestly, it's better to throw your clothes away yourself than to hand them over to this place. At least that way, you won’t feel cheated and heartbroken at the same time.

I gave my clothes here hoping for professional service, but what I received was beyond disappointing. The garments came back damaged, faded, and handled with zero care. Items I truly valued both sentimentally and financially were returned in a condition that made them completely unusable.

What’s worse is the attitude. No apology, no explanation, just casual indifference. You don’t just lose your clothes here you lose your trust, your peace of mind, and your money.

Avoid Trumble Dry if you actually care about your clothes. Their service doesn’t clean your garments, it destroys them.

featured_reviews.name: Saloni Bhandari
featured_reviews.review_text: They have completely ruined my bag, which is not something that can be reissued or replaced. On top of that, a couple of my dresses were damaged -  one lost its color and another came back with a missing belt. But the final straw was when my bag was entirely ruined. This is absolutely ridiculous and unacceptable.

featured_reviews.name: Tanuj Agarwal
featured_reviews.review_text: Terrible experience at the company. I gave my Under Armour shoes to them for cleaning, and they misplaced my sole then tried to give me some cheap sole and claim it's mine... be careful with them.

featured_reviews.name: Sören Dittrich
featured_reviews.review_text:
Somewhat pricey ( I feel) and a tad slow.
About 2kg of laundry/ 20 pieces took 4 days.
Handed stuff over on a Thursday morning, received it back on Sunday afternoon.

The quality of service was good, delivery to the hotel without extra charge. Everything is clean as expected and smells nice and fresh

But again, I felt it could have been faster.
If you are not in immediate need, would recommend.
